hook: Sony's The Social Reckoning just flopped, earning only 5.5 million dollars in its opening weekend.

sections.voiceover: Sony's The Social Reckoning just flopped, earning only 5.5 million dollars in its opening weekend.
Sony released The Social Reckoning in October 2026 with stars like Jeremy Strong and Mikey Madison. Why did The Social Reckoning struggle to compete against Universal's horror hit Other Mommy?
Except director David Fincher was notably missing from this production.
The film opened to a disappointing 5.5 million dollars at the box office. Moviegoers clearly preferred the 27.5 million dollar opening of Other Mommy over this Sony drama.
Check the box office numbers before booking your next ticket.
